name: Hiroshi Negishi
bio: Hiroshi Negishi (ネギシ ヒロシ, born June 18 or 20, 1960) is an anime director who got his start at Toei Animation, then join Tatsunoko Production and AIC and latter became one of the founders of the anime studio Radix. (Wikipedia)

credits.title: Tenchi Muyo! In Love
credits.overview: The demonic space criminal Kain has escaped from prison and destroyed the Galaxy Police headquarters. To ensure that the Jurai will not stop him, Kain travels back to 1970 to eliminate Tenchi's mother before he is even born. Now, Tenchi and the gang must travel to the past to stop him before he ceases to exist.
